name: SALMUBench
description: As multimodal models like CLIP become integral to downstream systems, the need to remove sensitive information is critical. However, machine unlearning for contrastively-trained encoders remains underexplored, and existing evaluations fail to diagnose fine-grained, association-level forgetting. We introduce SALMUBench (Sensitive Association-Level Multimodal Unlearning), a benchmark built upon a synthetic dataset of 60K persona-attribute associations and two foundational models: a Compromised model polluted with this data, and a Clean model without it.
